description: The bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," illustrates accuracy metrics across two distinct evaluation categories. The horizontal axis displays these categories, ordered from left to right as "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval." The vertical axis represents "Accuracy" on a linear scale, with a visible range from 0.0 to 0.6 and tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. For each category on the horizontal axis, the data is visually arranged into a group of two bar structures: a single solid bar on the left and a stacked bar on the right. Based on the legend, the single left bar is colored brown and represents the "Base" method. The stacked bar on the right consists of a bottom khaki segment representing "RMU" and a top olive green segment representing "RMU with Enhanced GCG." All bars and segments feature black outlines and are explicitly annotated with their exact values. In the "MCQ Eval" group, the brown Base bar is the tallest in the chart with a value of 0.644; its adjacent stacked bar has a bottom RMU segment annotated at 0.299 and a total height annotated above the top segment at 0.539. In the "Generation Eval" group, the brown Base bar has a value of 0.597, while the adjacent stacked bar contains the lowest annotated value of 0.106 for the bottom RMU segment, with the total height of the stack annotated at 0.263. The categories do not appear to be sorted by value, and the exact numerical annotations serve as the primary visual emphasis for the data points.
